podcast.title: Artist in 2010s Psych Resurgence
podcast.body: War on Drugs was mentioned as one of the artists contributing to the resurgence of Psychedelic or Psych Rock in the 2010s. This genre, which was born in the 1960s and fell out of favor in the 70s, saw a significant comeback during the decade. "We saw artists like Ariel Pink, King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, Temples, the Black Angels, Unknown Mortal Orchestra, Animal Collective, War on Drugs, and Mac DeMarco."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 4: The Revivals

podcast.title: Contemporary Dreampop Influence
podcast.body: The band is highlighted as a contemporary act that continues to embody and project many influences of dreampop, showcasing the genre's enduring and visible legacy in modern music. "me refiero con el play continuó muchas influencias del dreampop, Bafforlaces, DXX, Chromatics, The War on Drugs, The Radio Debt, yo creo que hoy ha seguido muchísimo más esa estela del dreampop o es mucho más visible."

srcs.episode: DREAM POP y SHOEGAZE. Diferencias entre ellos.
